items.description: Ensure primitive roles (Owner/Editor) are not assigned to standard user accounts.
items.current_value: 3 users assigned roles/editor, 2 users assigned roles/owner
items.recommended_value: 0 users on primitive roles; enforce Least Privilege RBAC
items.remediation_notes: Migrate users from roles/editor to domain-specific roles (e.g., roles/storage.objectViewer, roles/compute.instanceAdmin).

items.description: User-managed service account keys older than 90 days must be disabled and rotated.
items.current_value: 2 Service Account keys > 120 days old detected
items.recommended_value: No user-managed keys > 90 days; prefer Workload Identity Federation
items.remediation_notes: Adopt GKE Workload Identity or OIDC Federation to eliminate long-lived Service Account JSON keys.

items.description: All human administrators and users must have 2-Step Verification (MFA) enforced.
items.evidence_source: Google Admin SDK / Cloud Security Command Center
items.remediation_notes: Enable mandatory 2SV in Google Cloud Identity / Workspace admin console.

items.control_name: Workload Identity Federation for External CI/CD
items.description: Use Workload Identity Federation instead of static JSON keys for GitHub Actions / GitLab CI.
items.recommended_value: 100% of CI/CD pipelines use WIF without stored credentials
items.remediation_notes: Maintain pool attribute conditions to restrict access to specific GitHub repos.
